name: m4-manifest
description: The single declared list of checks that `make m4-check` (scripts/m4_check.py) runs. Every M4 native-parity scenario target, the WP4 persistence check and the PLAYABLE evidence sub-checks are listed here; tests/test_m4_check.py fails when a `test-m4-*` Makefile target or a tests/scenarios/*.json file is neither listed nor explicitly excluded with a reason, so a new scenario cannot be silently omitted. The acceptance terms are defined in docs/STATUS.md (epic #163); the required gameplay branches are declared in docs/evidence/M4/gameplay-branches.json.

clock.note: Every scenario boots by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on this one fixed session clock (ADR-0052); START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE with this seed. A scenario PASS is scoped to this clock and seed.

scenarios.name: house-cellar
scenarios.covers: enter the house through the window, take and light the lamp, move the rug, open the trap door, descend into the cellar, score; also runs the recorded strict frontier test (historical_m4_frontier_test.rkt, not parity)

scenarios.name: mailbox-drop
scenarios.covers: open the mailbox, take and drop the leaflet twice (INSERT-OBJECT, CHTYPE to SEGMENT), inventory, look

scenarios.name: orphan-prompt
scenarios.covers: the parser's orphan prompts `at what?` / `with what?` and their continuations (CHTYPE to/from CHARACTER)

scenarios.name: top-parser
scenarios.covers: TOP in SPARSE and EVERYTHING: dangling preposition, put all in, take all, drop all

scenarios.name: sword-glow
scenarios.covers: take the sword (TYPE of a DEFINEd FUNCTION), the SWORD-GLOW demon's faint and bright glow near the troll

scenarios.name: troll-combat
scenarios.covers: one combat branch: the troll dies on the third blow, the hero is never hit; diagnose, score, inventory after the fight

scenarios.name: parser-ambiguity
scenarios.covers: parser rejection messages, 5-letter truncation, empty and blank lines, buzz words, `Which door?` answered by an adjective, darkness

scenarios.name: cyclops-room
scenarios.covers: the maze into the Cyclops Room (ABS), feed, water, wake and flee the cyclops

scenarios.name: mirror-bat
scenarios.covers: the round room's RANDOM landings, rub mirror, the Bat Room (IMAGE, SLEEP under the fixed clock), the bat's RANDOM drop

scenarios.name: strange-passage
scenarios.covers: odysseus, the Strange Passage (room action TIME), c-int (verb function TIME), back to the living room

scenarios.name: help-info
scenarios.covers: help, info and ? through the read-only allowlist (ADR-0055 amendment)

scenarios.name: grue-resurrection
scenarios.covers: death by grue in the dark attic (JIGS-UP), `y`, resurrection in the forest, the carried sword, bottle and sack and the lamp scattered over RANDOM-LIST (no valuable: ROB-ADV's valuables branch not reached), the scattered objects seen again; prefix 11 (end of input at the question) ends by the game's QUIT (stale `n` in INBUF)

scenarios.name: grue-refusal
scenarios.covers: death by grue, `n`, FINISH <> (score and rank) -> RECORD (both OPENs denied, ADR-0055; natively writes MDL/ZORK.LOG) -> QUIT, the rest of the input unread (declared quit ending)

scenarios.name: troll-death
scenarios.covers: unarmed in the troll room: the troll staggers, wounds (ASTRENGTH -1, CURIN enabled) and kills the hero; `y`, resurrection with the wound kept, the lit lamp scattered; diagnose and score after death

scenarios.name: treasure-deposit
scenarios.covers: the painting taken in the Gallery (OFVAL 4), up the Studio chimney (CHIMNEY-FUNCTION, lamp plus one object), `open case`, `put painting in case`: ASCORE = RAW-SCORE + OTVAL 7 = 46, the case listed by `look`, `score`

scenarios.name: thief-robbery
scenarios.covers: observed under the fixed seed: the ROBBER demon's thief takes the painting from the hero in the Gallery and passes him again in the Studio; the painting stays in his bag (HOBJS); the thief is never seen in a room with the hero and never fought; prefix 12's end-of-input turn has him take it from the room

scenarios.name: cure-recovery
scenarios.covers: wounded by the troll (troll-death's path), back to the cellar; the CURIN clock counts down under WAIT and diagnose (28 -> 2) and CURE-CLOCK heals the light wound (ASTRENGTH -1 -> 0, CURIN disabled)

scenarios.name: lamp-burnout
scenarios.covers: the lamp on and 118 `wait`s: LNTIN 350 ticks, then LIGHT-INT's four dimmer warnings, `The lamp is dying.`, burn-out (OLIGHT? 0); `turn on lamp` refused; the dark cellar

scenarios.name: match-clock
scenarios.issue: epic #163 Phase 3b (objects beyond the house, other clock events)
scenarios.covers: the matchbook in the Dam Lobby (troll-combat's path, then the reservoir and the Dam): MATCH-FUNCTION queues the clock event MATIN (CTICK 2) at each `light match`; it fires at the next tick (`look`, and a `wait` that stops there), `turn off match` sets it to 0, the fifth light finds no match left (ORAND 0)

scenarios.name: boat-river
scenarios.issue: epic #163 Phase 3b (objects beyond the house, other clock events)
scenarios.covers: mirror-bat's path to Mirror Room 1, the pump from Reservoir North by the Atlantis Room, down the slide and back through the troll room to the Dam Base; the boat inflated with the pump, boarded (AVEHICLE), launched onto the River Frigid, landed, left, deflated and taken; the thief takes the grail and the trident from rooms the hero has left

scenarios.name: dam-sluice
scenarios.issue: #193 (INV-11; the #98 ADR amendment), epic #163 Phase 3b (objects beyond the house)
scenarios.covers: the Maintenance Room entered (MAINT-ROOM's #DECL names the undefined type PRSOBJ, not enforced); the wrench; `turn bolt with wrench` refused without GATE-FLAG; the yellow button (GATE-FLAG T); the bolt turned: the sluice gates open (LOW-TIDE T, the trunk visible); the drained reservoir, the trunk taken (RAW-SCORE 40 -> 55), across the reservoir bed to Reservoir North

scenarios.name: maint-leak
scenarios.issue: #193 (INV-11; the #98 ADR amendment), epic #163 Phase 3b (other clock events)
scenarios.covers: the Maintenance Room entered (MAINT-ROOM's #DECL names the undefined type PRSOBJ, not enforced); the blue button's leak queues the clock event MNTIN (CTICK -1, fires on every clock pass), the water level rises each turn and five times during `wait`; the putty plugs the leak (RVARS -1, MNTIN CTICK 0); the blue button jammed

scenarios.name: coal-machine
scenarios.issue: epic #163 Phase 3c (objects beyond the house: the coal-mine machine and basket)
scenarios.covers: the screwdriver and the dam's sluice gates (the drained reservoir), the mirror to the Altar's burning candles (CNDIN), the coal from the Dead End through the mine; coal, screwdriver and candles put in the basket and lowered (CAGE-TOP false); `drop all` for the empty-handed passage (EMPTY-HANDED, NO-OBJS) to the Lower Shaft lit by the candles (LIGHT-SHAFT scored); the machine's lid, the coal in, the switch turned with the screwdriver: the diamond (MSWITCH-FUNCTION); the diamond put in the basket and raised (CAGE-TOP T)

scenarios.name: gas-room
scenarios.issue: epic #163 Phase 3c (objects beyond the house: the gas room)
scenarios.covers: coal-machine's way to the Shaft Room with the burning candles; the Gas Room entered with the lamp only (BOOM-ROOM: nothing happens; the bracelet taken) and then with the burning candles: the coal-gas explosion, JIGS-UP's death question at READSTRING entry 58 answered `y` (patched in the forest)

scenarios.name: balloon-ledge
scenarios.issue: #196 (INV-12 resolved: attached declarations are not enforced, the attached-declaration ADR amendment); epic #163 Phase 3c (objects beyond the house: the balloon)
scenarios.covers: troll-combat's sixteen commands; the attic's rope, the Dam Lobby's guidebook and matchbook; the rope tied to the Dome Room's railing, the torch thrown at the glacier (GLACIER-FLAG); the Volcano Bottom: the receptacle opened, the guidebook put in, the basket boarded (BALLOON's READ-OUT with PRSO #FALSE ()), the guidebook burned (BINF GUIDE; BINT and BRNIN queued), the balloon risen to VAIR1 and VAIR2, landed on the Narrow Ledge, left; the wire tied to the hook (WIRE-FUNCTION, BTIE, BINT disabled) and untied; the balloon boarded again, risen off the ledge, descending after `close receptacle`, landed at the Volcano Bottom; `disembark`, `score` (54)

persistence.name: replay-persistence
persistence.covers: WP4 host persistence by deterministic replay (ADR-0061): troll combat saved at the RDCOM prompt, restored in-process and in a fresh process, verified against the native transcript; replay across SLEEP/TIME and help/info. A host-level proof of concept, not a player-facing save and not a scenario.

playable_subchecks.name: local-session-quit
playable_subchecks.covers: start, six commands, quit/n, inventory, quit/y through the game's own FINISH -> RECORD -> QUIT, byte-identical to native

playable_subchecks.name: local-launcher
playable_subchecks.covers: the local launcher run-zork and its CLI exit codes, EOF, fresh state per run, break propagation
